classical_burgess_interface.delta_choice: after absorbing C_r and polylog losses for large P, take any delta_B < (epsilon_B-1/(4r))/r
classical_burgess_interface.dyadic_packet_match: packet intervals are ordinary intervals after at most a two-piece split, so the same bound applies
classical_burgess_interface.large_branch_consequence: four large sides give the character-moment saving already registered by the Burgess-threshold router
classical_burgess_interface.standard_form: |S_I(chi)| <= C_r H^(1-1/r) P^((r+1)/(4r^2)) up to harmless log/P^o(1) loss

internalization_frontier.B1_interval_completion_and_translation: elementary normalization; must be written with endpoint/wrap constants
internalization_frontier.B2_vinogradov_shift_amplification: needs a self-contained lemma with A,B,r parameters and no hidden range loss
internalization_frontier.B3_amplified_moment_energy_ledger: needs the exact 2r-th moment expansion and collision-count bound
internalization_frontier.B4_weil_complete_rational_sum_kernel: needs the complete character-sum bound for non-perfect-power rational functions
internalization_frontier.B5_parameter_optimization_and_dyadic_uni: the exponent algebra is closed here; constants still depend on B2-B4

needed_pointwise_input.character: nonprincipal multiplicative character chi mod P; for prime P it is primitive

needed_pointwise_input.uniformity: epsilon_B fixed; constants may depend on epsilon_B but not on P, chi, or the dyadic packet

plain_conclusion: 当前唯一内部自足线的真正剩余已精确压缩为经典 Burgess 点态角色和证明的内部化。所需大包输入与素模经典 Burgess 定理严格匹配：对任意非主角色和长度 `H>=P^(1/4+epsilon_B)` 的区间，Burgess 形式经 `1/(4r)<epsilon_B` 的参数选择给出 `|S|<=H P^(-delta_B)`。因此若接受经典 Burgess 作为外部已证定理，RKS23 大包与已闭合薄包可合并闭合；若要求作者侧完全自足，剩余不再是含糊的角色矩黑箱，而是 Burgess 放大、2r 矩能量账本、Weil 完全有理函数角色和界，以及区间/常数统一性的内部证明包。行/列命题仍未在作者侧无条件闭合。
